raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]But we are now at the edge of the fog. Take one step further, and we step into the unknown.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: But we are now at the edge of the fog. Take one step further, and we step into the unknown.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Once, I hesitated. But the Doctor is right. We will overcome this crisis, as we have done so many times.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Once, I hesitated. But the Doctor is right. We will overcome this crisis, as we have done so many times.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: For we are together.

raw: Logos's bone pen draws through the air, the words coming out of his mouth, and the blessings soon after.
content: Logos's bone pen draws through the air, the words coming out of his mouth, and the blessings soon after.

raw: [name="Mechanist"]It's been a long time since we worked together so in sync, Logos. How are you feeling?

content: It's been a long time since we worked together so in sync, Logos. How are you feeling?

speaker: Logos
content: Focused.

raw: [name="Amiya"]Based on available information, there are more than just the core parts of PRTS in the Abyss.

content: Based on available information, there are more than just the core parts of PRTS in the Abyss.

raw: [name="Amiya"]An entity by the name of 'Priestess' may be sleeping in a Sarcophagus within.
speaker: Amiya
content: An entity by the name of 'Priestess' may be sleeping in a Sarcophagus within.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]If Priestess wakes up, she must be neutralized ASAP with the full force of all present.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: If Priestess wakes up, she must be neutralized ASAP with the full force of all present.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]It is the best way to prevent any mishap, Dr. {@nickname}.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: It is the best way to prevent any mishap, Dr. {@nickname}.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]The moment of her awakening will be her weakest... it will take time for her to adapt to her surroundings.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: The moment of her awakening will be her weakest... it will take time for her to adapt to her surroundings.

speaker: Amiya
content: Doctor...?

raw: You touch the wall in front of you. The strange sensation causes your heart to race.
content: You touch the wall in front of you. The strange sensation causes your heart to race.

raw: You have the feeling that this place was waiting for you... that you are the reason for its existence to begin with.
content: You have the feeling that this place was waiting for you... that you are the reason for its existence to begin with.

raw: The wall trembles. You seem to hear blaring sirens that threaten to burst your eardrums.
content: The wall trembles. You seem to hear blaring sirens that threaten to burst your eardrums.

raw: For an instant, you fall into a trance. Does the cacophony come from the present, or the past?
content: For an instant, you fall into a trance. Does the cacophony come from the present, or the past?

speaker: Amiya
content: The Abyss is changing!

raw: The wall begins to move irregularly, creating a rift.
content: The wall begins to move irregularly, creating a rift.
